sections.title: 1. Identity and address of the data controller
sections.content:
MAYA STONE IMPORTS, S.A. DE C.V. (hereinafter, "MAYA"), located at Blvd. Francisco Villa 4602, Warehouse A4, Col. León I, Zip Code 37235, León, Guanajuato, Mexico, is the data controller responsible for processing personal data collected from clients, prospects, users, visitors, suppliers, and any other data subjects interacting with MAYA.
• Privacy contact: info@gpomaya.com
• Phone & WhatsApp: +52 477 704 0874

sections.title: 2. Personal data we collect
sections.content:
Depending on interaction, we may collect: full name; company, studio, or organization; role or professional profile; email address; phone number; inquiry reason; material or category of interest; project description; preferred visit date and time; and fiscal details (RFC, billing address, tax regime) when required.
Technical browsing metrics (IP address, browser, operating system, timestamp, language) and cookie identifiers are also processed as detailed in our [Cookie Policy](/cookie-policy).

sections.title: 3. Sensitive personal data
sections.content: MAYA does not knowingly request sensitive personal data through standard website forms. We advise users not to submit sensitive information unless strictly required.

sections.title: 4. Means of collection
sections.content: Website forms; requests for information, quotes, or showroom appointments; email; phone; WhatsApp messages to +52 477 704 0874; and administrative user accounts where applicable.

sections.title: 5. Primary purposes (strictly necessary)
sections.content:
Indispensable purposes to address your inquiry:
Identify and contact you; fulfill requests regarding materials, projects, and showroom appointments; prepare and follow up on commercial quotations; coordinate visits and maintain inquiry communication; manage commercial relations, process invoices, and comply with fiscal and contractual obligations; prevent fraud; maintain system security; and administer user accounts.

sections.title: 6. Secondary purposes (consent required)
sections.content:
Sending newsletters and emails about new materials, collections, projects, or updates; commercial and promotional communications; event invitations; satisfaction surveys; and statistical analysis to improve our website and services.
You may opt out of these purposes at any time, without affecting the handling of your main request, by emailing info@gpomaya.com with the subject "Opt-out of secondary purposes". Every promotional email will also include an option to unsubscribe.

sections.title: 7. Consent
sections.content:
Implied consent is given for primary purposes upon submitting forms. Express consent will be gathered whenever legally required for secondary or sensitive data processing.
If data is ever processed for new purposes, additional consent will be requested.

sections.title: 8. Technology service providers
sections.content: MAYA relies on technology vendors that process data on MAYA's behalf for infrastructure, website hosting, storage, authentication, maps, social media content, measurement, and internal administration, including: Supabase (database, authentication, and files; region us-west-2, United States), the website hosting provider and its metrics tools, Meta (official Instagram API, Meta Pixel, and WhatsApp), Google Maps, and Google Gemini (internal administration). Details for each are available in our [Cookie Policy & Third-Party Technologies](/cookie-policy).

sections.title: 9. Data transfers
sections.content: MAYA may transfer data when necessary to comply with legal obligations, provide the services you requested, respond to requests from competent authorities, or when the transfer is permitted by law without requiring your consent. MAYA does not sell your personal data. Some of our technology vendors host information outside Mexico (for example, in the United States); in those cases they act as processors on MAYA's behalf and processing follows applicable Mexican law.

sections.title: 10. ARCO Rights
sections.content: You are entitled to Access, Rectify, Cancel, or Oppose (ARCO Rights) the processing of your personal data at any time.

sections.title: 11. Procedure for exercising ARCO rights
sections.content:
Send a request to info@gpomaya.com with the subject "ARCO Rights Request", providing your full name, contact details, the specific right you wish to exercise, and proof of identity.
MAYA will respond within a maximum of 20 business days (extendable by 10 days if justified). Exercising these rights is free of charge.

sections.title: 12. Revocation of consent
sections.content: You may revoke your consent at any time by emailing info@gpomaya.com with the subject "Consent Revocation".

sections.title: 13. Limitation of use or disclosure
sections.content: To limit the disclosure of your information or unsubscribe from communications, write to info@gpomaya.com with the subject "Data Limitation".

sections.title: 14. Cookies and tracking technologies
sections.content: Our platform utilizes cookies, local storage, and pixels for essential operations, security, analytics, and marketing. Full details are available in our [Cookie Policy](/cookie-policy).

sections.title: 15. Security and breach notification
sections.content: MAYA enforces administrative and technical safeguards to protect data. In the event of a significant security breach affecting your rights, you will be notified promptly pursuant to Mexican law.

sections.title: 16. Data retention
sections.content: Data is retained only as long as necessary to fulfill the intended purposes or legal obligations, undergoing a blocking period prior to ultimate deletion.

sections.title: 17. Minors
sections.content: This website is not aimed at minors. If a minor has submitted personal data without parental authorization, contact info@gpomaya.com for prompt removal.

sections.title: 18. Competent authority
sections.content: Following the legal reform of March 2025, the Mexican supervisory authority for private data protection is the Secretaría Anticorrupción y Buen Gobierno (SABG). You may appeal before this body should you consider your ARCO response non-compliant.

sections.title: 19. Modifications to this Notice
sections.content: MAYA may update this Privacy Notice periodically. The latest official version is always accessible in this [Privacy Policy](/privacy-policy).

cookies_page.title: Cookie Policy & Third-Party Technologies

sections.title: 1. What are cookies
sections.content: Cookies are files or identifiers that may be stored on your device while browsing our website. We also use local storage, pixels, tags, identifiers, and similar technologies.

sections.title: 2. Purpose of use
sections.content: To operate the website, remember your language and preferences, keep sessions active, protect restricted areas, record your consent decision, measure website performance and, when you authorize it, measure our marketing campaigns.

sections.title: 3. Categories
sections.content:
• Strictly necessary: language, sessions, authentication, security, and consent records. They cannot be disabled because the website would not work properly without them.
• Analytics & performance: visit statistics, pages viewed, events, and site speed, obtained through on-site tools, our hosting provider's metrics, and analytics applications. We use them to periodically review and improve website performance.
• Marketing: campaign and ad-interaction measurement through Meta Pixel. Only activated if you accept.

sections.title: 4. First-party technologies
sections.content:
• NEXT_LOCALE: remembers your selected language. Duration: 1 year.
• Consent decision (local storage): remembers whether you accepted or declined non-essential cookies. Duration: 180 days if accepted and 60 days if declined; after that we will ask again.
• Session and security cookies: keep you signed in if you have an account with us and protect restricted areas of the site (admin panel). They last for the session or the corresponding security period.

sections.title: 5. Supabase
sections.content:
We use Supabase for our database, user authentication, sessions, and file storage (project, collection, catalogue, and inventory images). It processes the information you provide through our forms.
• Project region: us-west-2 (United States).

sections.title: 6. Hosting & site analytics
sections.content: Our hosting provider and the analytics tools we use may log technical browsing data (such as IP address, browser, device, pages viewed, and load times) to operate the website securely and generate performance metrics. We use this information in aggregate to improve the site, not to personally identify you.

sections.title: 7. Meta (Meta Pixel)
sections.content: We use Meta technology to measure the performance of our advertising campaigns. This script is only loaded after you accept cookies in our consent banner; if you decline or do not respond, Meta Pixel is not activated in your browser.

sections.title: 8. Instagram (official Meta API)
sections.content: We display posts from our @gpomaya Instagram account obtained through Meta's official Instagram API. Images and videos are loaded from Meta's servers, so Meta may receive technical data about your connection (such as your IP address). If you click a post or our profile, you will be taken to Instagram and its own policies will apply.

sections.title: 9. Google Maps
sections.content: We use Google Maps on our contact page to show the location of our showrooms and studios. When the map loads, Google may process technical information and set its own cookies under its privacy policies.

sections.title: 10. Google Gemini
sections.content: We use Google Gemini as an internal tool for administration and content translation. This integration is restricted to our authorized team and does not automatically send our visitors' contact data to this service.

sections.title: 11. WhatsApp
sections.content: You can contact us on WhatsApp at +52 477 704 0874. When using this external platform, WhatsApp/Meta's own terms and policies apply.

sections.title: 12. Your consent
sections.content: When you visit our website, we show a banner where you can Accept or Decline non-essential cookies (analytics and marketing). Strictly necessary cookies always remain active, as the website would not work properly without them. Until you make a choice, non-essential cookies remain disabled.

sections.title: 13. Modifying your choice
sections.content: You can change your decision at any time using the "Cookie Preferences" button at the bottom of every page. You can also clear this site's cookies and browsing data from your browser settings; the consent banner will appear again on your next visit.

sections.title: 14. Browser-level blocking
sections.content: You may configure your browser to block cookies in general, although this may affect how some parts of the website work.

sections.title: 15. Retention
sections.content: The durations of our first-party technologies are listed in section 4. Third-party cookie durations depend on each provider's policy (Meta, Google, and our hosting provider).

sections.title: 16. Security
sections.content: We implement reasonable safeguards to protect our systems and the technologies described in this policy, although absolute security on the Internet cannot be guaranteed.

sections.title: 17. Policy modifications
sections.content: We may update this Policy when we add, remove, or modify technologies or providers, or when applicable legal requirements change. The current version will always be available in this [Cookie Policy](/cookie-policy).

block1.text: We work with a different rhythm of thought, understanding that true beauty lies in the clarity of our intention, not in ephemeral trends. Respecting the origin of natural stone implies understanding that it is not designed: it is discovered.

block2.text: Each block of natural stone is a time capsule. Its veins and textures are not imperfections, but the raw, honest, and tangible testimony of a world that was formed millions of years before our existence.

manifesto.p1: At MAYA we do not believe in absolute truths, we believe in what holds when the shine fades. Materials are not a superficial finish added at the end of a project, but a language that influences the perception of space, light, texture, and the experience of those who inhabit it.
manifesto.p2: Our work is to conduct an honest curation of the earth. We select fragments of history capable of responding to a real architectural and emotional intention, facilitating decisions that define the intimacy of spaces.

items.title: Raw curation
items.desc: Selection based on the material's potential to age with dignity and provide real aesthetic value.

items.title: Intimacy
items.desc: A dialogue from creator to creator, understanding the soul of the project before suggesting a surface.

items.title: Permanence
items.desc: Promoting surfaces that resist the passage of time and the ephemeral trends of the traditional market.

items.title: Material honesty
items.desc: A deep respect for the nature of the stone, avoiding alterations that hide its original essence.

items.title: Sensitive innovation
items.desc: Digital tools that bring the physical reality of stone into the architect's process: data sheets, catalogue and renders.
